verdict.rationale: Temporal is a workflow orchestration platform with a Web UI and CLI, so in-product AI insights, such as AI-suggested debugging of workflow histories, are a fair axis to ask about. The evidence pack shows no feature that generates insights or suggestions from the user's data. The AI material (Google ADK and Vercel AI SDK integrations, 'orchestrate AI apps and agents') consists of developer building blocks for building your own AI apps, which earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
